text:
sophie: Need a compact "Inference Playbook" mini visual pack for webinar + inbound routing one-pager. Deliverables: hero (1200x628 + 1080x1080), two microcards (cost vs latency, 800x800), routing slide (1920x1080), sticker-checklist (360x360). Deadline Tue EOD. Branch figma and add alt-text. https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook
ben: Confirming copy owner and color variants.
maria: I'll own copy. Hooks: A) "Serve smarter — cut inference unit cost by up to 2x." B) "Predictable latency. Predictable cost. Redwood Inference."
ben: Export spec: PNGs + SVG icons + PPTX. Filenames: playbook_hero_web_v1.png etc. Accessibility: contrast >=4.5:1 for body. Include alt-text files.
ada-designbot: Branch 'playbook-mini/1820000000' created; first-pass frames uploaded.
legal-bot: Add trademark line: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Inference, Inc." If using 3rd-party models add: "Model names are trademarks of their respective owners." Send final exports for review.
sophie: Priority order 1) hero, 2) slide + routing, 3) microcards, 4) stickers. Need first pass in 48h for rehearsal. Ping here with blockers. :rocket:
